actions.command: netsh advfirewall firewall set rule group="Network Discovery" new enable=No

revert.command: netsh advfirewall firewall set rule group="Network Discovery" new enable=Yes

tweaks.description: Set DNS to Cloudflare (1.1.1.1) for lower latency.

actions.command: netsh interface ip set dns name="Ethernet" static 1.1.1.1
netsh interface ip add dns name="Ethernet" 1.0.0.1 index=2

revert.command: netsh interface ip set dns name="Ethernet" dhcp

tweaks.description: Disable Nagle's algorithm for lower network latency in gaming.
Disable TCP auto-tuning for consistent network performance.

actions.command: netsh interface tcp set global autotuning=disabled

revert.command: netsh interface tcp set global autotuning=normal
